summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV, a Belgian-listed biotech (Euronext/Nasdaq: LKFT), filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly buyback activity under its June 9, 2026 repurchase program, executed by an independent intermediary via a discretionary mandate. Between September 28 and October 2, 2026, the company repurchased 117,437 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average of €25.99, spending €3,051,866.51, with prices ranging €25.34–€26.40 across XAMS, TQEX, CEUX and AQEU. Treasury holdings now total 1,751,031 shares. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or close date was disclosed. Watch pace, treasury-share ratio versus cancellation, and liquidity/dilution effects.
